source.title: CXL-DMSim: A Full-System CXL Disaggregated Memory Simulator With Comprehensive Silicon Validation
source.summary: Presents CXL-DMSim, an open-source full-system simulator modeling CXL.io and CXL.mem protocol semantics for disaggregated memory, validated against FPGA and ASIC CXL hardware with 3.4% average simulation error; published in IEEE TCAD 2025 and integrated into the SimCXL GitHub project.
